title: Preemptive Treament with acyclovir in intubated and mechanically ventilated patients with  Herpes simplex virus oropharyngeal reactivation and one or less organ failure (PTH2)
official: Preemptive Treament with acyclovir in intubated and mechanically ventilated patients with  Herpes simplex virus oropharyngeal reactivation and one or less organ failure (PTH2)
summary: Main objective: The primary objective is to show that, in mechanically-ventilated patients hospitalized in the ICU with HSV throat reactivation and 1 organ failure or less, a treatment with acyclovir reduces mortality at day 60 as compared to a placebo.
conditions: Patients in ICU with invasive mechanical ventilation and HSV throat reactivation with 1 or no organ failures.

interventions.name: CHLORURE DE SODIUM 0,9 % B. BRAUN, solution injectable en ampoule

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. aged ≥ 18 year-old
2. Invasive MV for 96 hours and planned to last for at least 48 hours longer
3. HSV reactivation in the throat (qualitative PCR positive for HSV on a throat swab)
4. Presence of 1 or less organ failure; organ failure being defined as a corresponding-organ SOFA score of 3 or 4 (for example, renal failure will be defined as a renal SOFA score of 3 or 4)
5. Written consent from the patient, from a close relative or from the person of trust previously appointed (or inclusion procedure in emergency situations)
6. Under social security cover
Exclusion criteria:
1. Hypersensitivity to acyclovir, to valacyclovir or to excipient
2. Decision of withholding/withdrawing care
3. Pregnant or breastfeeding (controlled by a urinary or blood pregnancy test)
4. Patient who received an antiviral drug active against HSV (acyclovir, valacyclovir, gancyclovir, valgancyclovir, foscarvir, cidofovir) in the previous 30 days
5. Duration of ventilation before randomization >15 days
6. Neutropenia, defined by an absolute neutrophils count < 1,000/mm3
7. Solid organ or bone-marrow transplant
8. Immunosuppressive treatment (including steroids at a dose >0.5 mg/kg/day of prednisone or equivalent for >1 month)
9. HIV infection
10. Moribund, defined by a SAPS II score at inclusion >75 points
